title: S01T01 - Define the product wedge, operator profiles, and non-goals
description: Define the technical jobs Boreal must perform better than adjacent tools, the Simple, Team, and Governed operator profiles, and the capabilities deliberately deferred. This is a product contract, not a user-recruitment or public-beta plan.
acceptanceCriteria: The product wedge names the technical jobs Boreal must outperform and the measurable invariants that distinguish it.
Simple, Team, and Governed profiles have explicit capabilities, defaults, safety boundaries, and non-goals.
Public launch, license changes, and real-user beta validation are explicitly deferred.
All repository changes are captured in scoped Git checkpoints or closeout records an accepted no-repo-changes reason.
Relevant automated checks and strict Boreal health diagnostics are run before closeout.
